verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AgentMail creating and hosting its own inboxes, and listing threads across those AgentMail inboxes organization-wide. Its IMAP/SMTP support runs the other way: it lets external clients like Outlook connect to an AgentMail inbox. Nothing documents connecting Gmail, Microsoft 365 or external IMAP accounts into AgentMail to work them from one place.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
